ns2:section.sectionText: RESIDENTAL LIFE/HOUSING Para-Professional Staff Course. 10 Week second half-session class. 2 hours (letter-graded) credit. 32328 RL1. Day and Time: Mondays, 3:00 - 4:50 pm, plus an extra class session on Saturday, March 1, 9:45 am to 5 pm. Location: Allen So. Rec. Rm. 40. START DATE: FEBRUARY 18, 2008. Courses for Housing Para-Professional Staff by application. See: http://www.housing.uiuc.edu/employment/reslife/Parapro_Selection/index.htm for courses and enrollment information. If you still have questions AFTER VIEWING THE WEBSITE, you can call Residential Life or Marc Goldman in Housing at 333-0770.
